title: BuddyBot
description: BuddyBot is an eco-friendly, AI-powered robot designed to support autistic children in learning, communication, and social interaction. By combining innovation with sustainability, BuddyBot creates an inclusive and engaging environment. This project won the IEEE IAS CMD Humanitarian Award, highlighting the chapter's commitment to using technology for humanitarian impact.
highlights: Winner of IEEE IAS CMD Humanitarian Award

title: Zaytouna Sense
description: Zaytouna Sense is a smart agriculture prototype using IoT and AI to support Tunisia's olive farmers through real-time monitoring, AI-driven irrigation recommendations, and early disease detection. This project won the IASTAM Tech Challenge, reflecting the chapter's technical expertise, creativity, teamwork, and commitment to sustainable engineering solutions.

title: Smart & Sustainable Olive-Centric Industrial Zones
description: This project proposed an innovative model for transforming Tunisia's olive sector through the integration of IoT, AI, blockchain, and renewable energy to improve smart irrigation, crop monitoring, energy efficiency, supply chain traceability, and waste-to-product conversion. It won 1st Place in the IAS Technical Challenge at TSYP12.

title: AI-Optimized School-Clinic Microgrids
description: An innovative AI-driven microgrid system combining solar energy, IoT, edge computing, and LSTM-based forecasting to provide reliable electricity for rural schools and healthcare clinics across Africa. The solution focused on improving vaccine preservation, enhancing educational infrastructure, reducing energy costs, and increasing climate resilience through intelligent energy management and sustainable community-centered design. This project earned the Third Prize in the IEEE Smart Village Student Project Competition.
